15.3 Serious Misconduct
The following are, without limitation, serious misconduct and may lead to termination without notice or
notice pay:
 (a) theft, fraud, forgery, falsification of records including timesheets and expense claims;
(b) wilful damage to Company or client property;
(c) unauthorised disclosure, removal or destruction of Company or client data;
(d) sexual harassment, physical violence, threats or intimidation;
(e) accepting or offering a bribe or kickback;
(f) reporting for work under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance;
(g) conviction for an offence involving moral turpitude;
(h) concurrent employment in breach of Clause 10.3;
(i) deliberate misrepresentation in the employment application or during background verification;
(j) repeated wilful insubordination or refusal to carry out lawful instructions.
15.4 Inquiry Process
Where serious misconduct is alleged, the Company issues a written charge sheet setting out the
allegations and the evidence relied upon, and gives the employee not less than seven (7) days to respond
in writing. An Inquiry Officer, who has had no prior involvement in the matter, conducts an inquiry at which
the employee may be accompanied by a colleague of their choice, may see the evidence, and may
cross-examine witnesses.

17. Definitions
Anchor day — the one working day each week on which a team is expected to be co-located in the office,
published by the team's manager.
Band — the career level assigned to a role, from B1 to B8, as set out in Clause 2.4.

Confirmed employee — a permanent employee who has successfully completed probation and holds a
confirmation letter, or who is deemed confirmed under Clause 3.4.
Continuous service — uninterrupted service with the Company, treating approved leave, statutory
maternity leave and Company-directed deputation as service.
Cost to Company (CTC) — the aggregate annual cost of employment, comprising Fixed Pay, Variable
Pay and Retirals.
Date of joining (DOJ) — the date on which the employee first reported for duty, as recorded on
PeopleHub. Leave accrual, gratuity and long-service recognition run from this date.
Delivery Operating Model (DOM) — the engagement-level document that records working hours, shift
pattern, on-site requirements and escalation contacts for a client engagement.
Fixed Pay — the guaranteed annual cash component of CTC, excluding Variable Pay and Retirals.
Full and final settlement (F&F) — the closing account between the Company and a separating employee,
as described in Clause 16.3.
Loss of Pay (LOP) — a day of absence for which no leave balance is available and for which salary is not
paid.
Net working hours — recorded in-office or logged-in duration excluding the meal break.
PeopleHub — the Nexora human resources management system of record.
NexServe — the Nexora IT service management and asset management platform.
NexSpend — the Nexora travel, expense and reimbursement platform.
NexoraLearn — the Nexora learning management system.
Weekly off — Saturday and Sunday, unless a different pattern is recorded in the engagement's Delivery

1. Purpose, Scope and Principles
1.1 Purpose
This Policy establishes a single, uniform framework for leave entitlement, leave administration, attendance
recording and absence management across Nexora Technologies Private Limited. It replaces all earlier
location-specific practices, including the separate Bengaluru attendance addendum of March 2019 and the
Pune shift-attendance note of July 2022, both of which stand withdrawn with effect from 1 January 2026.
1.2 Scope
This Policy applies to all employees on the Nexora payroll, including probationers, Graduate Engineer
Trainees after deployment, and fixed-term contract employees. It does not apply to interns engaged for
fewer than ninety (90) days, to independent contractors, or to staffing-partner deputees, whose absence
arrangements are governed by their own contracts.
Where a provision of this Policy is less favourable than a mandatory requirement of the Shops and
Commercial Establishments legislation of Haryana, Karnataka or Maharashtra, or of any other applicable
statute, the statutory provision prevails to the extent of the shortfall, and the HR Operations team will apply
the statutory position without requiring an application from the employee.
1.3 Governing Principles
 1. Leave is planned. Except for sickness and genuine emergency, leave is applied for and
approved before it is taken.
 2. Leave is an entitlement, not a favour. A manager may decline leave only for a
documented business reason and must offer an alternative window.
 3. Attendance is a record, not a surveillance instrument. Attendance data is used for
payroll, statutory registers, client billing and capacity planning. It is not used to evaluate individual
performance in isolation.
 4. Rest is not optional. Managers are accountable for ensuring that their team members
take leave. An employee carrying more than twenty-five (25) days of unused Earned Leave on 30
September triggers an alert to the manager and the HRBP.
1.4 The Leave Year
The Nexora leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December. It deliberately differs from the financial year
(1 April to 31 March) and from the performance year (1 April to 31 March). Leave balances, carry-forward,
lapse and encashment are all calculated on the calendar year.

3. Casual Leave (CL)
3.1 Purpose and Quantum
Casual Leave covers short, unplanned personal absences: a domestic emergency, a civic appointment, a
school event, a vehicle breakdown, a religious observance not covered by the holiday calendar. The
entitlement is twelve (12) days per leave year, credited three (3) days on the first day of each quarter.
3.2 Rules
 1. Casual Leave may be taken in units of half a day or one full day.
2. Not more than three (3) consecutive days of Casual Leave may be taken at one time.
An absence longer than three days must be applied as Earned Leave.
 3. Casual Leave may not be combined with Earned Leave in a single continuous absence, except
where the Casual Leave is the first or last day of the absence and the total absence does not exceed five
(5) days.
 4. Casual Leave may be prefixed or suffixed to a weekly off or a public holiday. Intervening
weekly offs and holidays are not counted against the Casual Leave balance.
 5. Unused Casual Leave lapses on 31 December. It is not carried forward and is not
encashable, on separation or otherwise.
 6. Casual Leave credited for a quarter that has not yet begun may not be availed in advance.
3.3 Notice
Casual Leave requires a minimum of one (1) working day's advance notice on PeopleHub. Where the
circumstances make advance notice impossible, the employee must inform the reporting manager by
telephone or message before 10:00 IST on the day of absence and must regularise the application on
PeopleHub on the first working day after return.

4. Sick Leave (SL)
4.1 Purpose and Quantum
Sick Leave covers absence caused by the employee's own illness, injury, medical procedure, or a
medically advised period of quarantine or recovery. The entitlement is twelve (12) days per leave year,
credited in full on 1 January.
4.2 Rules
 1. Sick Leave may be taken in units of half a day or one full day.
2. Sick Leave for more than two (2) consecutive working days must be supported by a
medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner, stating the period of advised rest. The certificate
is uploaded to PeopleHub within seven (7) calendar days of return.
 3. Sick Leave for more than five (5) consecutive working days additionally requires a
fitness-to-resume certificate before the employee returns to work.
 4. Sick Leave for more than ten (10) consecutive working days is reviewed by the HRBP,
who may, with the employee's consent, refer the case to the Company's medical adviser and may convert
the balance of the absence to Earned Leave or to Special Leave.
 5. Sick Leave may not be applied prospectively except for a scheduled medical procedure, for
which the application may be made in advance with supporting documentation.
 6. Sick Leave may be used for the hospitalisation of a spouse, dependent child or dependent
parent, up to a maximum of five (5) days in a leave year, on production of the discharge summary or
admission record.
 7. Unused Sick Leave lapses on 31 December. It is not carried forward and is not encashable.
4.3 Exhausted Sick Leave
Where an employee's Sick Leave is exhausted, further medical absence is applied against Earned Leave,
and thereafter against Casual Leave, and thereafter as Loss of Pay. In cases of serious illness supported
by medical documentation, the CHRO may sanction Special Leave on full or half pay for up to sixty (60)
days in a leave year.

5. Earned Leave (EL)
5.1 Purpose and Quantum
Earned Leave, also referred to as Privilege Leave, is intended for planned rest and personal commitments
requiring an extended absence. The entitlement is eighteen (18) days per leave year, accruing at one and
a half (1.5) days for each completed calendar month of service.
5.2 Rules
 1. Earned Leave may be taken in units of half a day or one full day. There is no maximum
duration, subject to approval.
 2. Earned Leave of three (3) or more consecutive days requires seven (7) calendar days'
advance notice. Earned Leave of five (5) or more consecutive days requires fifteen (15) calendar days'
advance notice. Earned Leave of ten (10) or more consecutive days requires thirty (30) calendar days'
advance notice and the additional approval of the Delivery Manager and the HRBP.
 3. Earned Leave may not be availed in advance of accrual. An employee whose accrued balance
is insufficient may apply for the shortfall as Loss of Pay.
 4. Weekly offs and public holidays falling within a period of Earned Leave are counted
against the Earned Leave balance where the leave period exceeds five (5) continuous calendar days. For
absences of five days or fewer, intervening weekly offs and holidays are not counted.
 5. An employee on Earned Leave for fifteen (15) or more continuous days must complete a
documented handover to a named backup, recorded on PeopleHub before the leave begins.
5.3 Carry Forward and Lapse
A maximum of thirty (30) days of unused Earned Leave may be carried forward from one leave year to the
next. The carry-forward is computed at the 31 December closing.
Any Earned Leave balance in excess of thirty (30) days on 31 December is automatically encashed in the
January payroll of the following year at the rate of:
 Encashment per day = (Monthly Basic Salary + Dearness Allowance) ÷ 30
Automatic encashment is a payroll event; no application is required. It is taxable as salary income and is
reflected in the payslip under "EL Encashment".
Worked example: an employee with a monthly Basic of INR 62,000 and no Dearness Allowance holds 37
days of Earned Leave on 31 December 2026. Thirty days are carried forward to 2027; seven days are
encashed at INR 2,066.67 per day, giving INR 14,466.69, credited in the January 2027 payroll.
5.4 Encashment on Separation
On separation, accrued and unused Earned Leave up to a maximum of thirty (30) days is encashed in the
full and final settlement at the rate in Clause 5.3, computed on the last drawn Basic Salary. Earned Leave

A manager who declines a leave request must record a business reason in the PeopleHub comment field
and must propose at least one alternative window within the following sixty
 (60) days. Generic reasons such as "project pressure" are not acceptable; the reason must
identify the specific delivery commitment at risk.

Approved leave may be cancelled by the employee up to the day before the leave begins, directly on
PeopleHub. Cancellation of leave already commenced requires manager approval and is effective from the
date of return to work. Leave cancelled after the start date is re-credited only for the days not availed.

Leave during the notice period requires the approval of the function head in addition to the reporting
manager. Approved leave during notice extends the last working day by an equivalent number of calendar
days, unless the function head expressly waives the extension in writing on PeopleHub. Casual Leave and
Sick Leave credited but unused at the date of resignation may be availed during the notice period subject
to this clause; they are not encashable.

One (1) day of special paid leave per leave year on production of the donation certificate from a licensed

Paid time off on the day of a general election, State assembly election or local body election in the

Paid time off for attendance at a court, tribunal or statutory authority in response to a summons, on

12.4 Leave for Sporting and Cultural Representation
Up to five (5) days of special paid leave per leave year for an employee selected to represent the State or
the country in a recognised sporting or cultural event, on production of the selection letter from the
recognised federation.
12.5 Quarantine and Public Health Directions
Where a public health authority directs an employee to isolate or quarantine, the period is treated as paid
special leave and is not deducted from any leave balance, on production of the direction. Where the
employee is able to work from home during the period, normal attendance applies and no leave is
deducted.
12.6 Leave for Employees with Disabilities
An employee with a benchmark disability as certified under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act,
2016, is entitled to an additional four (4) days of paid leave per leave year for medical review, therapy,
assistive device fitting or related purposes. This entitlement is in addition to Sick Leave and does not
require exhaustion of any other balance.

leave in a rolling twenty-four-month period, on medical certification. The application is handled directly by
the CHRO's office, is not visible to the reporting manager on PeopleHub, and is recorded as Special Leave
without further description.

15. Frequently Asked Questions
Q1. My Casual Leave for the quarter is exhausted and I need a day off next week. What are my
options? Apply for Earned Leave if you have an accrued balance. If not, you may apply for Loss of Pay
with your manager's approval, or you may use a Compensatory Off if you hold one.
Q2. I fell ill on a day I had applied for Casual Leave. Can I convert it? Yes. Raise a modification
request on PeopleHub within seven days of return, attaching the medical documentation if the absence
exceeded two days.
Q3. Do weekends count against my Earned Leave? Only for absences of more than five continuous
calendar days. For an absence of five days or fewer, intervening weekly offs and public holidays are not
deducted.
Q4. I earned a Compensatory Off in March and it is now June. Can I still use it? No. Compensatory
Off must be availed within sixty days of the date earned, after which it lapses. Your March credit expired in
May.
Q5. Can I encash my Casual Leave when I leave the Company? No. Only Earned Leave, up to a
maximum of thirty days, is encashable on separation.
Q6. I am a new father. How much leave do I get and when must I take it? Ten working days, in up to
two blocks, taken within six months of the date of birth or the date of handover of an adopted child.
Q7. My manager has not acted on my leave request for four days. What happens? It escalates to your
skip-level manager on day 3 and is auto-approved on day 5, unless it is a sabbatical, special leave, or a
request for more than fifteen days.
Q8. I have 34 days of Earned Leave. What happens on 31 December? Thirty days carry forward. The
remaining four days are encashed automatically in the January payroll at (Basic + DA) ÷ 30 per day, and
the amount is taxable.
Q9. I am moving from Pune to Bengaluru for a six-month deputation. Whose holiday calendar
applies? Bengaluru's, because the deputation exceeds thirty continuous days.
Q10. Independence Day 2026 falls on a Saturday. Do I get a compensatory day? No. A holiday falling
on a weekly off is not compensated with an alternative day.

5. The Buddy Programme
5.1 Purpose
Every new joiner is assigned a buddy for the first thirty (30) days. The buddy is the person a new joiner
asks the questions they would not ask their manager: where the good coffee is, what "ODC" stands for,
whether it is normal to still feel lost in week two, who actually knows how the deployment pipeline works.
5.2 Who Can Be a Buddy
A buddy must be a confirmed employee, in the same team or an adjacent team, at the same band or one
band above the new joiner, with at least six months at Nexora, not in the new joiner's reporting line, and not
carrying more than one buddy assignment at a time.
A buddy assignment is recognised: the buddy receives an allowance of INR 3,000 on completion of the
thirty-day period and a positive closing note from the new joiner, and the assignment is recorded against
the buddy's people-contribution goal in the performance review.
5.3 What a Buddy Does

5.4 What a Buddy Does Not Do
A buddy does not set goals, assess performance, approve leave, handle a grievance, or discuss
compensation. A buddy who becomes aware of a wellbeing concern, a policy breach or a POSH matter
refers it to the HRBP rather than handling it; the referral itself is not a breach of the new joiner's confidence
and must be made.

9. Onboarding for Internal Moves and Returners
9.1 Internal Transfers
An employee moving to a new team or function goes through a shortened onboarding: no Induction Week,
no buddy allowance, but a mandatory 30-60-90 day plan, a named point of contact in the new team, and a
role-specific track from Clause 4.3 where the role family changes.
Access changes must be requested through NexServe by the receiving manager and the releasing
manager jointly. Access to the previous team's systems and client environments is revoked within
twenty-four (24) hours of the effective transfer date. This is audited monthly by the Information Security
team; standing access after a transfer is a reportable finding.

 HR Frequently Asked Questions 
 
      Owner:  HR Communications  ·  Last updated: 2024-11-08  · 
      Last reviewed: 8 November 2024  ·  Classification: Internal Use Only 
 leave attendance payroll separation faq 
 
 
 Heads up.  This FAQ is a plain-English summary maintained by the
      HR Communications team. It is  not  the policy. The controlled documents
      live on PeopleHub → Policies. If something here contradicts a policy
      document, the policy document wins.
     
 Leave 
 
 How much leave do I actually get in a year? 
 Forty-two days of paid leave, plus public holidays. It splits like this: 
 
 Type Days How you get it Does it carry over? 
 Casual Leave (CL) 12 3 days land on 1 Jan, 1 Apr, 1 Jul, 1 Oct No — use it or lose it on 31 Dec 
 Sick Leave (SL) 12 All 12 on 1 January No 
 Earned Leave (EL) 18 1.5 days for every full month you work Yes, up to 30 days 
 
 The leave year is the calendar year (January to December). This trips people
      up because the appraisal year and the financial year both run April to March. 
 
 
 Can I take Casual Leave for a week? 
 No. Casual Leave maxes out at three consecutive days. Anything longer has to
      be Earned Leave, and you need to give notice — seven days for a three-day break,
      fifteen days for five days or more. 
 
 
 I worked a Saturday. How long do I have to use the comp-off? 
 45 days from the date you earned it.  After that it lapses and
      it is not encashable. Your manager has to raise the comp-off request on PeopleHub
      — it is not automatic just because you badged in on a weekend. 
 
 
 My partner is having a baby. What leave can I take? 
 Paternity Leave is  5 working days , taken within six months of
      the birth. Upload the birth certificate on PeopleHub. If you are the birthing
      parent, Maternity Leave is 26 weeks for your first two children. 
 
 
 What happens to Earned Leave I do not use? 
 Up to 30 days rolls into next year. Anything above 30 days on 31 December is
      encashed automatically in the January payroll at (Basic + DA) ÷ 30 per day, and it
      is taxable. You do not need to apply for this. 
 
 
 Do weekends get deducted if I take a long holiday? 
 Only if the absence runs longer than five continuous calendar days. For a short
      break, the weekend in the middle is free. 
 
 Attendance and working from the office 
 
 How many days do I have to be in the office? 
 If you are on the Hybrid designation,  12 working days a month ,
      including your team's anchor day. Site-Anchored roles (IT Support, Facilities,
      Reception, Security, lab and hardware work, and anyone on a client engagement with
      an on-site clause) come in every working day. Fully Remote is an exception that
      needs your function head and the CHRO to sign off,  and it is reviewed every six
      months. 
 
 
 What counts as a full day? 
 
 Net hours logged What it counts as 
 8 hours or more Full day 
 4.5 to 7.99 hours Half day — half a day of leave comes off 
 Under 4.5 hours Absent — a full day of leave comes off 
 
 Net hours exclude the one-hour meal break. You need both an access-card swipe
      and a PeopleHub check-in; one without the other shows up as an exception on your
      manager's dashboard. 
 
 
 I keep getting in after 11. Does it matter? 
 Yes. After 11:00 IST without a prior exception is a late mark. Three in a month
      costs you half a day of Casual Leave. More than eight in a month is treated as an
      attendance deficiency and your manager has to counsel you formally. 
 
 
 I forgot to swipe. Can I fix it? 
 Regularise it on PeopleHub within seven calendar days. You get three
      regularisations a month without needing HRBP approval. 
 
 Pay and payroll 
 
 When does salary hit my account? 
 The last working day of the month. If that is a bank holiday it moves earlier,
      never later. Payslips appear on PeopleHub → My Pay by the third working day
      of the following month. 
 
 
 I changed my bank account on the 22nd and salary went to the old one. 
 The payroll input cut-off is the 18th. Anything after that lands in the next
      month's run. There is no off-cycle payment for this. 
 
 
 Why is my take-home so much less than my CTC ÷ 12? 
 Because CTC includes variable pay, the employer PF contribution and the
      gratuity provision, none of which are paid to you monthly, and because PF,
      professional tax and income tax come off the monthly figure. The worked example in
      the Compensation, Benefits and Payroll Policy walks through it line by line. 
 
 Leaving Nexora 
 
 What is my notice period? 
 90 days  once you are confirmed, whatever your band. During
      probation it is 30 days on either side. Your function head and the CHRO can agree
      to shorten it, in which case you pay notice-shortfall recovery on
      (Basic + DA) ÷ 30 per day. 
 
 
 Can I use up my Earned Leave instead of serving notice? 
 No. Leave cannot be set against the notice period, and any leave you do take
      during notice pushes your last working day out by the same number of days unless
      your function head waives it in writing. 
 
 
 When do I get my full and final settlement? 
 Within 45 days of your last working day, provided asset return and clearance
      are done. Form 16 for that year comes by 15 June, sent to the personal email
       address on your PeopleHub profile — so make sure that is current before you
      leave. 
 
 Benefits 
 
 Who is covered on the medical policy? 
 You, your spouse and up to two dependent children, on a INR 5,00,000 family
      floater. Parents or parents-in-law can be added on the top-up at your cost.
      Enrolment windows are 30 days from joining, 30 days from a life event (marriage,
      childbirth, adoption), or the 1 July renewal. 
 
 
 Can I talk to someone confidentially? 
 Yes. Ashray Wellbeing Services runs our Employee Assistance Programme —
      1800-102-8899, eight free sessions a year for you and each immediate family
       member. Nexora only ever sees anonymised usage numbers, never who called or what

      was said. 
 
 Still stuck? 
 Raise a ticket on PeopleHub → Helpdesk or write to
     hrhelpdesk@nexoratech.in . First
    response within one business day, resolution within three. For anything about
    conduct,  ethics or harassment, use the channels on the
     Speak Up  page instead — those do not go through the HR helpdesk
    queue.

 IT Setup Wiki for New Joiners 
 
      Owner: Deepak Bhatia, Director - IT  ·  Last updated: 2026-02-26  · 
      Last reviewed: 26 February 2026  ·  Classification: Internal Use Only 
 onboarding laptop vpn access acceptable use 
 
 Written for people in their first fortnight. Everything here assumes you have
    already collected your laptop from the IT desk on day one. If you have not, raise a
    P2 on NexServe and tell your manager — do not wait. 
 Day 1 — before you do anything else 
 
 Sign in and enrol MFA.  Your account is
      firstname.lastname@nexoratech.in. First sign-in forces a password change and MFA
      enrolment. Use the Microsoft Authenticator app; SMS fallback is available but is
       being retired in the second half of 2026. 
 Check the device is enrolled.  Open NexServe → My Assets
       and confirm your serial number is listed against your name. Disk encryption,
      endpoint protection and the DLP agent are pre-installed. If any shows
      "Non-compliant", raise a P2 — a non-compliant device is blocked from client
      environments. 
 Connect to the VPN.  Nexora Secure Access. The profile is
      pushed automatically; if it is missing, install it from Company Portal. 
 Set up Slack.  You are added to #general, #site-gurugram or
      your site channel, and your team channel. Set your display name to your full name,
      not a handle. 
 
 
 System What it is for When you get it 
 Microsoft 365 / SSO Email, calendar, Teams, documents Provisioned 10 days before you join 
 PeopleHub Leave,  attendance, payslips, goals, policies Active from day 1 
 NexServe IT tickets, assets, software catalogue Active from day 1 
 NexSpend Travel booking, expense claims, reimbursements Active from day 1 
 NexoraLearn Mandatory courses, catalogue, certifications Active from day 1 
 GitLab / Jira / Confluence Code, tickets, documentation Day 1, once your manager approves 
 Client environments Client systems and data Day 5–15, needs client approval 
 
 Standard kit 
 
 Who Laptop Peripherals Mobile 
 B1–B3 engineering 14",  16 GB, 512 GB Dock, 24" monitor, headset No 
 B4–B5 engineering 14", 32 GB, 1 TB Dock, 27" monitor, headset No 
 B6+ 14", 32 GB, 1 TB Dock, 27" monitor, headset Corporate handset and plan 
 Design / Data Science 16" workstation, 32 GB, discrete GPU Dock, 27" colour-calibrated monitor No 
 
 Need something outside the standard kit — a second monitor, a vertical mouse, an
    ergonomic chair, a larger memory configuration? Raise a NexServe request with a
    one-line business or medical reason. Ergonomic requests supported by an
    occupational-health note are approved without further debate. 
 Ticket priorities and what they actually mean 
 
 Priority Use it when Response Resolution 
 P1 You cannot work at all,  or a client-facing service is down 30 minutes 4 hours 
 P2 Significant impairment with no workaround; new joiner blocked 2 hours 1 business day 
 P3 Everything else — software installs, peripherals, access changes 1 business day 3 business days 
 P4 Requests with a future date; bulk provisioning 2 business days Agreed date 
 
 The IT desk is at Level 3 in Gurugram, Level 6 in Bengaluru and Level 3 in Pune,
    staffed 09:00–19:00 IST. Outside those hours a P1 pages the on-call engineer. 
 Software 
 Install from the NexServe software catalogue. Anything not in the catalogue needs
    a request with a business justification and, for anything that touches client data, a
    security review. Do not install unlicensed software, and do not use a personal
    licence for work — both are breaches of the Acceptable Use Policy. 
 Generative AI — the short version 
 
 Use the enterprise instances provisioned by Nexora.  Personal accounts,
      personal API keys and unapproved browser extensions are not permitted for work. 
 No client-confidential material, no personal data, no credentials, no

      proprietary source code goes into any service that is not on the approved list. 
 Some clients prohibit AI-assisted development outright. The engagement's
      Delivery Operating Model records the position for your client — check it before
      you start, not after. 
 Anything a model generates, you own. Review it, test it, licence-scan it. The
       reviewer is accountable for the code as if they had written it themselves. 
 
 Things that will get your access suspended 
 
 Plugging a personal USB drive into a Nexora laptop. 
 Forwarding work email, code or documents to a personal address. 
 Sharing your password, MFA token or access card. Even once. Even with your
      own manager. 
 Turning off the VPN on an untrusted network. 
 Not completing your mandatory courses.  At day 45 everything except PeopleHub
      and NexoraLearn is suspended until you finish them. 
 
 Lost or stolen device 
 Report it to NexServe  and  security-incident@nexoratech.in within
    24 hours. If it went missing outside Company premises, file a police FIR and send a
    copy. Reporting quickly is what protects you; the Company can recover the depreciated
    value up to INR 40,000 only where the loss followed demonstrable negligence, and
    prompt reporting weighs against that finding. 
 Working from home 
 You need a stable connection of at least 20 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, a quiet
    place for client calls, and a power arrangement that survives an outage. The
    INR 1,500 monthly internet and telephone allowance is paid with salary against a
    declaration — you do not submit bills for it. A UPS or inverter for your router is
    claimable once every three years under the wellness and workplace category, up to
    INR 8,000.

      Owner: Accounts Payable, Finance & Accounts  ·  Last updated: 2026-01-19  · 
      Last reviewed:  19 January 2026  ·  Classification: Internal Use Only 
 travel expenses nexspend per diem advance 
 
 How to get travel approved, how to book it, and how to be reimbursed without a
    three-week argument with Finance. Governed by FIN-POL-006. 
 
 The two rules that cause 90% of rejected claims. 
      (1) Approval before travel, recorded on NexSpend — not a Slack message, not a
      verbal yes. (2) Claims within 30 days of the trip ending.
     
 1. Getting approval 
 
 Type of travel Approvers Raise it by 
 Domestic, same-day Reporting manager 2 working days before 
 Domestic, overnight Reporting manager + Delivery Manager 5 working days before 
 International Function head + CFO 15 working days before 
 Client-billable travel As above + written client approval attached As above 
 Long-term deputation (90+ days) Function head + CFO + CHRO 30 days before 
 
 2. Booking 
 Book through Trailhead Corporate Travel — the desk is reachable at
    travel@nexoratech.in or on the NexSpend "Book travel" tile. Self-booked travel is
    reimbursed at the  lower  of what you paid and what the desk could have got,
    and only where you had written approval to self-book first. In practice, self-booking
    an expensive last-minute fare is the most common way people end up out of pocket. 
 3. Entitlements 
 
 Band Air (domestic) Rail Hotel / night (metro) Hotel / night (non-metro) Daily allowance 
 B1–B3 Economy AC 2-Tier INR 5,500 INR 4,000 INR 1,200 
 B4–B5 Economy AC 1-Tier INR 7,500 INR 5,500 INR 1,600 
 B6–B7 Economy; Business above 6 hours AC 1-Tier INR 10,000 INR 7,500 INR 2,200 
 B8 and ELT Business AC 1-Tier Actuals, reasonable Actuals, reasonable INR 3,000 
 
 Metro for this purpose means Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai,
    Kolkata and Pune.  The daily allowance covers meals and incidentals and does not need
    bills. If the client provides meals, claim the reduced allowance of 40%. 
 Local travel 
 
 Mode Rate Evidence 
 Own car INR 12 per km Trip log with start and end points 
 Own two-wheeler INR 5 per km Trip log 
 Cab / ride-hailing Actuals App invoice showing the route 
 Auto-rickshaw Actuals up to INR 300 per trip Self-declaration acceptable 
 Airport transfer Actuals Invoice 
 
 4. Claiming 
 
 Open NexSpend → New Claim and link it to the approved travel request.
      A claim with no linked request goes to Finance for manual review and adds about a
      week. 
 Attach an original tax invoice for every line above INR 500. A card statement
      is not an invoice. A screenshot of a booking confirmation is not an invoice. 
 Enter the GSTIN where the vendor issued a GST invoice to Nexora — the Company
      cannot claim input credit without it, and Finance will send the claim back. 
 Submit within 30 days of the trip ending. Between 30 and 60 days needs your
      function head's approval. Beyond 60 days needs the CFO, and is normally refused. 
 
 
 Stage Owner Service level 
 Manager approval Reporting manager 3 working days 
 Finance verification Accounts Payable 5 working days 
 Payment Payroll / AP Next payment run — Tuesdays and Fridays 
 Query or rejection Accounts Payable Explained in the NexSpend comment thread 
 
 5. Advances 
 A travel advance of up to 80% of the estimated cost is available for trips over
    INR 25,000 or any international trip.  Settle it within 15 days of returning.
    Unsettled advances are recovered from payroll without further notice, and you cannot
    hold two open advances at once. 
 6. What is not reimbursed 
 
 Alcohol, other than at an event approved in advance by the site head. 
 In-flight wifi, seat selection and priority boarding, unless the flight is
      over six hours. 
 Fines, penalties, traffic challans and parking tickets. 
 Personal entertainment, minibar, laundry on trips under four nights, and spa
      or gym charges. 
 Travel insurance bought separately — Nexora already covers you on approved
      travel. 
 Costs for a family member accompanying you, including the difference on a
      shared room. 
 Anything paid in cash above INR 10,000 in a single transaction — disallowed
      under section 40A(3) of the Income-tax Act, 1961. 
 
 
 Expense fraud.  Claiming for something you did not spend, altering
      an invoice, or splitting a claim to duck an approval threshold is serious
      misconduct under the Code of Conduct, clause 2.7. Finance samples 8% of claims for
      substantive testing every month and every claim above INR 50,000.
